The Dynasty

The piece that transforms a room.

At 145 pounds and 48 inches, The Dynasty does not decorate a space — it defines one. Every collector who has placed it reports the same thing: the room is different. Guests notice it before they notice anything else. Interior designers ask about it before they ask about the architecture.

I
Sodalite with lapis lazuli inlayThe wing panels are not painted or stained — they are inlaid lapis lazuli, a separate stone cut and fitted by hand. In direct light, the wing separates into three distinct blues.
II
90-lb amethyst cathedral baseThe base is a naturally occurring cathedral geode — a geological formation that took approximately 80 million years to develop. It weighs 90 lbs independently. No equivalent base can be sourced or made.
III
Agate tail feather translucencyThin-cut agate is used for the tail feathers — chosen because agate transmits light, giving the feathers a luminous quality that solid stone cannot achieve.
IV
145-lb room-scale presenceAt this weight and scale, The Dynasty requires professional placement — and rewards it. It is a permanent acquisition, not a seasonal decoration.

Origin

Minas Gerais, Brazil

The amethyst cathedral at the base of The Dynasty formed approximately 80 million years ago in a volcanic cavity in southern Minas Gerais. It was mined by a family operation that has been working the same deposits for three generations. The sodalite used for the macaws was selected from the same region — chosen for its color density and the quality of its blue.

One cathedral. One chance.

The amethyst cathedral base cannot be replicated or sourced again. When The Dynasty sells, this configuration ceases to exist. No equivalent will be made. Professional installation available in South Florida.
